newsitem.title: USA: Mediq sees acquisitions in fiscal 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mediq sees acquisitions in fiscal 1997.

text.p: Mediq Inc said Thursday it anticipates making strategic acquisitions in fiscal 1997 and is now "seriously investigating a possible transaction" which could be "significant" to the company.

The company made the statements in a press release with its year-end and fourth-quarter results for fiscal 1996. It was not more specific, except to say it could not assure the transaction would occur.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment further.

The company said Thursday it lost $0.69 a share in the fourth quarter, compared with $0.22 a share in the year-ago period. Of those figures, the company had a loss from discontinued operations for the quarter of $0.47 a share and $0.12 a share respectively, it said.
